prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pearland, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1174; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give a recorded statement today. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's okay. You have my claim information already.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was driving on a multi-lane road in Pearland, Texas, heading toward the freeway. It was in the right lane, and I was trying to move over to the middle lane.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I checked my mirror, didn't see anyone, and started to change lanes. Then I felt a bump on my left side and my car got pushed sideways.
Q: Did the other vehicle signal or try to avoid you?
A: I didn't see a signal. It happened fast. The other car was partly beside me, and I think they were drifting over too.
Q: How fast were you traveling?
A: Maybe thirty-five or forty miles an hour. Traffic was moving but not heavy.
Q: Did you stop at the scene or move your vehicle?
A: I pulled onto the shoulder. I was shaking and my head was pounding.
Q: Can you describe your injuries?
A: I hit my head on the side window. I had a headache right away, I felt dizzy, and the light bothered my eyes. I also had some trouble focusing on what people were saying for a while.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or medical provider since the accident?
A: Yes, I was evaluated at an urgent care clinic and then I saw my primary care doctor. They said I have a concussion and told me to limit screen time and rest.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Some, yes. The headaches come and go, and I get tired faster than usual.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I believe the other driver was at fault for moving into my lane. I'm still working through my medical care, so I may need to follow up.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
